update_unit: one Wolff cluster flip; store every stride flips after warmup flips
initialization: even replica indices random independent spins; odd indices all +1
uncertainties: One standard error from leave-one-replica-out jackknife of the pooled-moment estimators.
observables: N=L^2. e=<E>/N; abs_m=<|M|>/N; cv=Var(E)/(NT^2); chi=Var(M)/(NT); chi_abs=Var(|M|)/(NT); binder=1-<M^4>/(3<M^2>^2). k_B=1.
cluster_check: At h=0, chi_cluster=<size of seed cluster>/T. chi_cluster_minus_sym subtracts <M^2>/(N*T) using <M>=0 by symmetry. Its SE uses paired replica differences.
autocorrelation: Within-replica centered, biased FFT autocovariances pooled over replicas; Geyer initial monotone sequence. tau in retained measurements; ESS=replicas*samples/(2*tau). Reliable flag requires a truncation point and samples >= 50*tau; not an equilibrium test. nan denotes an undefined estimate.
equilibration_check: Difference of the energy-per-spin means for the random and ordered starts; SE from independent within-group replica means. This checks a single observable.
